**From:** Jay <jay@atliq.com>
**To:** B.K. Verma <bkverma@steelcore.in>
**Date:** 2026-02-05
**Subject:** Power BI dashboards for plant operations — overview

Mr. Verma, good speaking with you last week. As discussed, attaching an overview of the production and dispatch dashboards we'd propose, with an indicative estimate of 14–16k depending on data source complexity.

Jay

---
**From:** B.K. Verma <bkverma@steelcore.in>
**To:** Jay <jay@atliq.com>
**Date:** 2026-02-10

Jay — frankly the number is a problem. A local freelancer has quoted us less than a third of this for "the same dashboards". Why should we pay AtliQ rates?

---
**From:** Jay <jay@atliq.com>
**To:** B.K. Verma <bkverma@steelcore.in>
**Date:** 2026-02-14

Fair question. The difference is usually in the data plumbing — connecting your ERP and weighbridge systems properly so the dashboards stay accurate without manual uploads, plus documentation and handover. A freelancer building on top of Excel exports will look identical for the first month. Happy to get on a call and walk through exactly what's included.

title: Email Thread: VoltEnergy — competitor comparison
body:
# Email Thread: VoltEnergy — competitor comparison
**From:** Marcus Chen <m.chen@voltenergy.com>
**To:** Karandeep <karandeep@atliq.com>
**Date:** 2026-06-15
**Subject:** RE: Proposal — energy trading dashboards

Karandeep,

Straight question: we're also evaluating a Tableau consultancy for this. Their pitch is that Tableau handles our real-time trading feeds better. Give me your honest counter — why Power BI, and why AtliQ?

Marcus

---
**From:** Karandeep <karandeep@atliq.com>
**To:** Marcus Chen <m.chen@voltenergy.com>
**Date:** 2026-06-17

Marcus, honest answer: for sub-second streaming both tools need an intermediate layer, so the real-time argument is mostly marketing. Where Power BI wins for you is cost at your user count (you're already on Microsoft E5) and our proposal includes the data model build, not just the visuals. Happy to put both TCOs side by side if useful.

---
**From:** Marcus Chen <m.chen@voltenergy.com>
**To:** Karandeep <karandeep@atliq.com>
**Date:** 2026-07-01

That TCO comparison would actually help a lot — board asks for 3-year numbers. Can you send it this week?

# Email Thread: DataNest — renewal and a third engineer
**From:** Sameer Kulkarni <sameer@datanest.io>
**To:** Karandeep <karandeep@atliq.com>
**Date:** 2026-06-30
**Subject:** Contract renewal + team expansion

Karandeep,

Both engineers have been excellent — genuinely part of the team now. Two things:

1. Our contract runs out end of September. Can we sort the renewal early so there's no gap?
2. We've raised a Series A and want to add a third engineer, ideally someone strong on Kafka. Same arrangement?

Sameer, that's great to hear on both counts — congratulations on the raise. Let's do a call Wednesday 8 July to lock the renewal and discuss the Kafka profile. Invite coming.

# Internal — Pipeline Review (monthly)
**Date:** 2026-07-02 · **Attendees:** Bhavin, Dhaval, Karandeep, Jay

- Reviewed CRM export before meeting. Numbers don't feel right — several deals everyone "knows about" aren't in there, or are stale.
- Jay spent ~2 hours before this meeting reconciling CRM against inboxes and still found gaps (Meridian proposal Q&A sitting unanswered, the Harbor & Finch intro from Suresh, TechSummit leads only half-entered).
- Karandeep: "I answer emails on my phone between meetings and it never gets into the system. By the time I'm at a laptop it's gone."
- Bhavin: NovaPharma security questionnaire deadline is real — end of July or we slip a year. Who owns it? (Unresolved in meeting.)
- Dhaval: Sunrise Foods came back wanting a v2 three weeks ago. Still no call scheduled. "That one's on me."
- Agreed (again) that everyone updates CRM same-day. Same agreement as April's meeting.
- TechSummit: ~15 business cards collected. 4 entered in CRM so far (Jay).

# Internal — which deals first? (7 Jul, ad-hoc)
Present: Bhavin, Karandeep, Jay (Dhaval travelling)

Argument about where the week goes. On the table:
- FinEdge (L-1023, 95k) — compliance cleared 19 Jun, they asked for a commercial call, nobody confirmed. Bhavin: "biggest deal we have and it's been sitting three weeks."
- NovaPharma (L-1029, 80k) — security questionnaire due 24 Jul, still untouched, Pranav hasn't responded to the forward.
- ShopSwift (L-1017, 55k) — Elena needs SOW by 15 Jul or budget slips a quarter.
- Meridian (L-1003) — Sanjay's proposal questions from 16 Jun still unanswered. Their budget review is mid-July.
- HealthFirst board meets 14 Jul — should we ping Anita before? Nobody had this date until Karandeep searched his inbox during the meeting.

Jay pointed out the CRM says none of this — statuses stale, next_followup mostly empty, half the urgency lives in inboxes. Karandeep: "we find out what's urgent by accident."

No owners assigned by end of meeting. Bhavin took FinEdge "probably".
